svg.title: Everything on one machine: the whole platform on one Raspberry Pi 5 or one VM, what to plug in and how to install it
svg.text: One Raspberry Pi 5 on a desk, or one VM or PC.
The whole platform, on one board or one machine
For a home lab or a demo. Up to 4 devices.
Debian 12 or Ubuntu 22.04 or newer. The same parts.
On a VM, the hypervisor passes each USB capture card through.
Then open http://<address>:5073 and add your devices.
images are built on the Pi
Outgrow it? The Pi stays useful as a host next to the devices,
and the rest moves to a Proxmox node.
